question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Secure
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Safe'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **'Secure',** which signifies being protected against threats or other forms of danger or risk. **(सुरक्षित)**.

 
 
• **Example: **The building has been made secure with new locks and an alarm system.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym is **'Safe'**, which also denotes being protected from or not exposed to danger or risk. **(सुरक्षित or सचेत)**.
 
 
• **Example: **Wearing a helmet while riding a bike makes you safer.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Secret' **refers to something that is not known or seen or not meant to be known or seen by others. (गुप्त or रहस्य).
 
• **'Independent' **suggests being free from outside control; not depending on another's authority. (स्वतंत्र).
 
• **'Comfortable'** indicates a state of physical ease and freedom from pain or constraint or feeling relaxed. (आरामदायक or सुखद).
